skill.name: founder-brand-kickoff
skill.description: Checks founder-brand setup and weekly progress to recommend onboarding, missing content inputs, or the next topic in rotation.
skill.summary: Choose the next founder-brand task from setup gaps, content pools, and weekly posting progress.

content.value_statement: Founders can lose time deciding between brand setup and weekly content work. This skill checks readiness and posting progress to recommend the next task.
actual_capabilities: Checks for brand configuration and voice-profile files to identify onboarding needs.
Checks four content pillars for at least three topics each.
Checks readiness for at least five voice phrases and three stories.
Uses cadence and weekly post counts to choose completion or content-generation routes.
Suggests a topic and alternatives for the next pillar rotation slot.
Defines welcome and status responses showing setup progress and the next task.
limitations: Depends on the broader founder-brand skill pack for onboarding and downstream drafting workflows.
Provides state-detection pseudocode, not an executable parser or standalone program.
Requires accessible configuration, voice information, and post records for accurate routing.
Does not provide publishing integrations, analytics collection, or a performance guarantee.

use_cases.title: Start a founder-brand program
use_cases.description: Identify missing configuration and begin the onboarding route before planning weekly posts.

use_cases.title: Prepare a weekly writing session
use_cases.description: Review posting progress and select a topic from the next content pillar.

use_cases.title: Review a client setup
use_cases.description: Check topic pools, voice phrases, stories, and cadence to identify the next preparation task.

prompt_templates.title: Find the starting point
prompt_templates.prompt: Where do I start with founder-brand? Check whether my brand setup is ready and recommend the first task.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner with an incomplete or unknown setup.

prompt_templates.title: Review program status
prompt_templates.prompt: /founder-brand status. Summarize my configuration, topic pools, voice phrases, stories, cadence, and posts logged this week.
prompt_templates.scenario: User checking progress after initial onboarding.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the next weekly topic
prompt_templates.prompt: What is next for my content this week? Use my cadence and logged posts to suggest the next pillar topic and alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Regular writer preparing the next scheduled post.

prompt_templates.title: Audit readiness before drafting
prompt_templates.prompt: Review all four topic pools, voice phrases, stories, cadence, and weekly completion. Identify the first unmet routing condition before recommending a draft.

output_examples.input: Where do I start? My brand configuration is missing.
output: Prepare your voice profile, four topic pools, and posting cadence.

output_examples.input: All setup checks pass. My cadence is four posts weekly, two are logged, and Process is the next slot.
output: This week: Two of four posts logged.
Suggested pool topic: How we review customer feedback.
Alternatives: Our weekly planning routine; How we prioritize product fixes.

output_examples.input: All setup checks pass, and I have logged four posts against a weekly cadence of four.
output: This week: Four of four posts logged.
Return on Monday for the next rotation.

best_practices: Keep configuration and weekly post records current before requesting the next task.
Prepare at least three topics per pillar, five voice phrases, and three anonymized stories.
Review suggested topics and confirm drafting before continuing to downstream skills.
anti_patterns: Expecting this router to replace the full onboarding or drafting skill pack.
Treating example status values as measurements of your own progress.
Using confidential emails or identifiable customer stories without permission and anonymization.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It checks founder-brand readiness and weekly progress, then recommends the next setup or content task.

faq.question: How is it activated?
faq.answer: The parent founder-brand skill loads it on bare invocation. It also lists questions about getting started or choosing the next content task.

faq.question: What information does it need?
faq.answer: It expects brand configuration, a SOUL voice profile, topic pools, stories, cadence, and weekly posting records.

faq.question: What readiness thresholds does it use?
faq.answer: It checks four pillars with three topics each, five voice phrases, three stories, and a positive weekly posting cadence.

faq.question: Does it publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No publishing integration is provided. Weekly mode suggests a topic and asks whether to draft it.

faq.question: What happens when the weekly target is complete?
faq.answer: It reports that the queue is complete and recommends returning on Monday for the next rotation.
